final: WITH per_product AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(item_count) AS total_count FROM per_product), shares AS (SELECT item_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share FROM per_product CROSS JOIN total), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares), filtered AS (SELECT per_product.item_count, shares.share, shares.share - avg_share.mean_share AS difference FROM per_product CROSS JOIN shares CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE shares.share > avg_share.mean_share) SELECT SUM(item_count), AVG(share), AVG(difference) FROM filtered
